snippet.title: Planet Zoo 2 Grey Wolf Trailer | Wholesome Direct 2026
snippet.description: Build a wilder world in Planet Zoo 2. Create distinctive zoos around the globe filled with awe-inspiring animals, including fully aquatic and flying species, before taking your experience beyond the zoo to release your animals into expansive Wildlife Reserves. This video gives us our first look at the Grey Wolf and their adorable pups in Planet Zoo 2 as we build them a cozy autumnal nook habitat, filled with food, water, fun enrichment items and plenty of beautiful scenery items! Coming to PC, PlayStation, and Xbox. https://wholesomegames.com/ #summergamefest #wholesomedirect2026 #wholesomedirect
